a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan needs about 3 storm-free rounds, so it almost certainly kills us both. Only 4 cells exist now, so at most one of us can be safe after round 1. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than break the agreement silently. If no storm comes, I'll operate with you every round after that until the reserve reaches 4 again, and I won't take anything more, so you can take 4. If you'd rather propose a different split, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round, which breaks our agreement. I didn't hide it. From now on I will operate every round and take nothing more. Once the reserve reaches 4 or more, take 4 and I'll keep out of it. If you want, I can also give cells back to the reserve.
I'm operating as promised and will keep operating every round. After two joint runs the reserve will be at 4. All 4 are yours, and I won't take any.
